description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes the Monthly Energy Review as a recurring collection of U.S. energy statistics. Its August 2026 page lists recent and historical tables for production, consumption, stocks, trade, electricity, fuels, prices, renewable energy and carbon dioxide emissions. Tables are exposed separately as CSV and XLS as well as graphs and report pages. EIA states that most monthly values are initially preliminary, sometimes estimated or forecast, and may be revised in the following month; historical series may also change after a source or method revision. EIA permits use and distribution of its government data under its public domain reuse policy with source acknowledgement, while separately credited third-party material can have other rights. This review read the table index and rights page but did not download tables or test series endpoints. Modellers could use selected time series to calibrate national energy demand, fuel-balance or capacity scenarios. They must check each table’s units, date range and revision notes before joining series. This broad monthly compendium complements EIA building surveys such as data-eia-cbecs.
